trans.cn_source: （在某地）居住的，居留的；常驻的；属于（某个群体）的；（鸟、蝴蝶等）非迁徙性的；（计算机程序、文件等在存储器中）驻留的

sentences.c: Local resident groups have united in opposition to the plan.
sentences.cn: 当地居民团体已联合起来反对这项计划。

sentences.c: A resident of his neighbourhood had let off fireworks to celebrate the revolution.
sentences.cn: 他邻里的一个居民燃放了烟花来庆祝革命。

sentences.c: They cover preventative care for the local resident.
sentences.cn: 他们为当地居民提供预防保健服务。

synos.cn: 居住的；住院医师；定居的
